# <id> profile (values skills read)
> Copy to docs/users/<id>/profile.md. Original of personal values: the person's Drive Claude folder 00_profile (D-20261103-3). No emails, phones or keys here.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Name | |
| git user | (`git config user.name`) |
| STWS assignee number | |
| Mailboxes | (kinds only, e.g. Gmail, Outlook — no addresses, R-SEC-02) |
| Mail scope | (folders/senders in words — no addresses) |
| Drive Claude folder | (folder ID) |
| Role | |
| Time zone | (required, e.g. America/Los_Angeles, D-20261105-1) |
| Boss | (optional) |
| Work log file | docs/log/YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD_<id>.md |
